description: MetaRalph Phase 1: Core Infrastructure - Set up the foundational daemon, database, configuration, and CLI framework for the autonomous multi-project orchestration engine.

userStories.title: Initialize TypeScript project with dependencies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the project scaffolding so that I can start building MetaRalph with proper TypeScript configuration and all required dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json exists with name 'metaralph', version '0.1.0'
Dependencies include: better-sqlite3, commander, ink, react, uuid
DevDependencies include: typescript, @types/node, @types/better-sqlite3, @types/react, tsx
tsconfig.json configured for ESM with strict mode
src/ directory exists
npm install completes successfully
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create structured logger utility
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a logging utility so that all MetaRalph operations are logged consistently with timestamps and log levels.
acceptanceCriteria: src/utils/logger.ts exports a Logger class
Supports log levels: debug, info, warn, error
Each log entry includes ISO timestamp and level
Logs to stdout by default
Can be configured with a log file path
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create configuration management
userStories.description: As a user, I need MetaRalph to load configuration from ~/.config/metaralph/config.json so that I can customize its behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: src/utils/config.ts exports loadConfig() and saveConfig() functions
Creates ~/.config/metaralph/ directory if it doesn't exist
Returns default config if config.json doesn't exist
Default config includes: dbPath, logsPath, maxConcurrentWorkers (3), selfImprovementEnabled (true)
Config is validated with TypeScript types
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Set up SQLite database with initial schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the database layer so that MetaRalph can persist projects, tasks, executions, and learnings.
acceptanceCriteria: src/db/index.ts exports initDatabase() function
Creates SQLite database at configured dbPath
Creates tables: project_groups, projects, conversations, messages, tasks, executions, learnings
Uses better-sqlite3 for synchronous operations
Includes proper foreign key constraints
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create CLI entry point with commander
userStories.description: As a user, I need a CLI interface so that I can interact with MetaRalph via terminal commands.
acceptanceCriteria: bin/metaralph is an executable Node.js script
Uses commander for CLI argument parsing
Implements 'metaralph --version' showing version from package.json
Implements 'metaralph --help' showing available commands
Placeholder commands registered: start, stop, status, projects, groups, queue, workers
package.json has 'bin' field pointing to bin/metaralph
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement daemon lifecycle (start/stop/status)
userStories.description: As a user, I need to start and stop the MetaRalph daemon so that it can run continuously in the background.
acceptanceCriteria: src/daemon/index.ts exports startDaemon(), stopDaemon(), getDaemonStatus() functions
Daemon writes PID to ~/.config/metaralph/metaralph.pid when running
'metaralph start' starts the daemon process (detached)
'metaralph stop' sends SIGTERM to the daemon process
'metaralph status' shows whether daemon is running and uptime
Daemon logs startup and shutdown events
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create project registry with opt-in management
userStories.description: As a user, I need to add and remove projects from MetaRalph so that it only works on projects I explicitly authorize.
acceptanceCriteria: src/registry/index.ts exports addProject(), removeProject(), listProjects() functions
addProject(path) validates path is a git repository
addProject extracts project name from directory name or package.json
Projects are stored in the database with id, name, path, added_at
'metaralph projects' lists all registered projects
'metaralph projects add <path>' adds a project
'metaralph projects remove <id>' removes a project
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create project groups for related repositories
userStories.description: As a user, I need to group related projects (e.g., microservices + API) so they can be managed together as a single unit.
acceptanceCriteria: src/registry/group.ts exports createGroup(), addToGroup(), removeFromGroup(), listGroups() functions
Groups stored in project_groups table with id, name, description
Projects can optionally belong to a group (group_id foreign key)
'metaralph groups' lists all groups with their projects
'metaralph groups create <name>' creates a new group
'metaralph groups add <group> <path>' adds a project to a group
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Initialize progress.txt and make initial commit
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Ralph infrastructure files committed so that future Ralph iterations can build on this foundation.
acceptanceCriteria: progress.txt exists with initial header and Phase 1 completion notes
.gitignore includes node_modules/, dist/, *.db, *.log
All source files are committed to the ralph/phase-1-core-infrastructure branch
Commit message follows format: 'feat: [US-XXX] - Title'
Typecheck passes
